digest.component_or_area: adapters/jira_family sub-seam and Jira Data Center backend
propositions: PR #120 proposed a second Jira adapter that duplicates field-mapping logic and reaches into private modules, creating an undocumented shared layer with no contract and no structural protection against drift.
Three independently-maintained copies of status/priority maps have already drifted; consolidating them into a single definition in jira_family/ is required to prevent further divergence.

Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) cannot relocate without breaking the dynamic loader, so the shared layer must be built via dependency inversion rather than file moves.

Jira Cloud and Data Center diverge on three axes (REST API version, auth mechanism, user-identity model) which must be abstracted as parameterized contracts (RichTextCodec, UserIdentityModel) rather than hardcoded or duplicated.

The DC transport must reject non-https URLs and never disable certificate verification, requiring operator configuration of ca_bundle and resolved_statuses with explicit allow_insecure override for testing.

Structural enforcement via import-linter or AST-walking tests is required to prevent future contributors from breaking the seam boundary by adding Cloud-specific logic to the shared jira_family layer.
